explanation: Breastfeeding advice omits the duration qualifier ('during treatment and for 3 weeks after last dose') given in evidence, reading as an indefinite prohibition. Also omits male-partner contraception duration (3 months), though not stated as false.
suggested_rewrite: ...and advise against breastfeeding during treatment and for at least 3 weeks after the last dose. Also counsel male patients with female partners of reproductive potential to use contraception during treatment and for 3 months after the last dose.
